audit.whatIsWrong: The published chart disagreed with the packet AND with its own whys in the last three rows: it gave Gangplank Level 6, Illaoi First item, and Illaoi 2+ items.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Gangplank / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Skill / Gangplank. The prose says the same thing — whys[4] 'the skirmish flattens back to even', whys[5] 'it stays a wash', whys[6] 'she's helpless the instant she's pulled off her field'. Giving the scaling champion the 2+ item row also matches a 51.78% Gangplank win rate.
audit.corrected: Level 6 Gangplank 7/10 -> Skill 5/10, First item Illaoi 4/10 -> Skill 5/10, 2+ items Illaoi 4/10 -> Gangplank 6/10, in both layers as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect line says it outright: NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0. Every spike said 'when she does X' with nothing to count.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 on 900 range and Leap of Faith is 120/95/70 — those two numbers are the only windows in the lane, because Harsh Lesson is a 4s cooldown you cannot wait out.
audit.corrected: E's 14s and 900 range into spikes[1] and early, E's 13s and Leap of Faith's 95s into mid, Harsh Lesson's 4s into early.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to run from the spirit — 'a spirit vessel you must run from', 'a spirit vessel I have to chase or flee from', and 'walk the vessel out of tentacle range'. Riot's E text: 'If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.' Running away from your own spirit is precisely what makes you a Vessel. Harsh Lesson's auto-reset tell and the passive's healing were also missing.
audit.why: This is the single worst error in the slice: the advice tells you to do the exact thing that loses the lane, and it appeared in three separate fields. Becoming a Vessel spawns tentacles around you permanently and is how Illaoi wins.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], early, mid and wants.you[1] all now say to stay near your spirit and move it out of tentacle reach rather than fleeing. Harsh Lesson (W) named as a 4s dash and auto reset in early; the passive's champion-hit healing tied to an anti-heal buy in mid.
sources: brief enemyKit E and P text

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames ('Powder Kegs', 'My Cannon Barrage') are false positives — correct names with a leading word.
audit.corrected: No name changes made on that basis.

edits.before: Her E (Test of Spirit) is the kill button: it rips a spirit vessel you must run from, and every tentacle near it slams the vessel to chunk the real you — stay out of E cast range when you go for CS.
edits.after: Test of Spirit (E) is the kill button on 900 range and 14s: every tentacle near your spirit slams it to chunk the real you, and running away from the spirit is what makes you a Vessel. Stay outside 900 when you farm.

edits.before: Save Remove Scurvy and right-click-cancel to break free the moment she lands E, then walk the vessel out of tentacle range before it gets slammed
edits.after: Never run from your spirit after E — distance turns you into a Vessel; stay near it, out of tentacle range, and Remove Scurvy the slow

edits.before: Level 1 is mine — she has no E yet and only a stray passive tentacle, so I last-hit with Parrrley at range and chip her for free without ever stepping into a slam. The second she hits 3 it inverts: her E rips out a spirit vessel I have to chase or flee from, and any tentacle near it pounds the vessel to damage the real me. Do NOT trade in melee here. Drop a Powder Keg at max distance, detonate it with Q, and pull straight back before a tentacle winds up. The cardinal sin in this lane is eating E next to a cluster of her tentacles — that's not a trade, that's a death.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — she has no E yet and only a stray passive tentacle, so last-hit with Parrrley at range and chip her for free without ever stepping into a slam. The second she hits 3 it inverts: Test of Spirit (E) rips out your spirit on 14s, and any tentacle near it pounds the spirit to damage you. Do NOT trade in melee, and do NOT sprint away — leaving your spirit behind is what turns you into a Vessel. Drop a Powder Keg at max distance, detonate with Q, and pull back before a tentacle winds up. Harsh Lesson (W) is a 4s dash onto you and an auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue to step out.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are her strongest window — her tentacle count is climbing, her E is a live kill threat, and my kegs still sit on long cooldowns and low HP she can free-hit to deny. So I farm with Parrrley and flatly refuse the field fight. If she does land E on me, I burn Remove Scurvy and right-click to break the pull, then walk the vessel out of tentacle range so nothing can slam it. At 6 my Cannon Barrage finally answers her R — when she leaps in and erupts a fresh ring of tentacles, I drop Barrage on that ring so she can't sit in her own field to swing them, and the skirmish evens back out.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are her strongest window — her tentacle count is climbing, Test of Spirit is a live kill threat on 13s, and your kegs still sit on long cooldowns and low HP she can free-hit to deny. Farm with Parrrley and refuse the field fight. If E lands, Remove Scurvy the slow but stay close to your spirit — walking away from it is what makes you a Vessel — and step it out of tentacle reach instead. At 6 Cannon Barrage answers Leap of Faith on 95s: when she erupts a fresh ring, carpet it so she cannot stand in her own field to swing them. Her tentacles heal her off every champion hit, so buy anti-heal before you commit to a long trade.

notes: PRIORITY: this page told the player to run away from their own spirit after Test of Spirit, in three separate fields. Riot's text is explicit that getting too far from the spirit is what turns you into a Vessel — the advice inverted the mechanic. Fixed everywhere it appeared. The chart also disagreed with the packet and with its own whys in the last three rows and is corrected as an atomic group. Two things I did NOT write: Leap of Faith carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's description is only 'smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage ... A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit' — no dash denial — so I made no grounding claim; and the content still says 'right-click to break the pull' in places I did not edit, which I could not verify from the kit. The whole content layer for this matchup is also in FIRST person; I converted what I edited, but whys[0] through whys[6], late, spikes[3] and wants.you[0]/[2] still read as 'I' and 'my'.
